values.description: API base URL. Use https://sandbox.swiftship.ai for the sandbox, https://api.swiftship.ai for production, or http://localhost:3000 for local dev.
Server-to-server API key from the admin portal (Settings → API keys). Use a sk_test_ key against the sandbox and sk_live_ against production.
Your tenant id. Visible in the admin portal URL (/t/<tenantId>/...). Not secret, but useful to log for support.
